data.title: Designer - AI Organisations
data.description:
About the Company

The OpenAI Deployment Company ("DeployCo") is the deployment arm of OpenAI, purpose-built to deliver enterprise AI transformation at scale. As model capabilities accelerate, deployment has become the primary constraint to realizing AI value creation within large enterprises. DeployCo bridges that gap.

Our ambition is to build the company that defines AI deployment. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, enterprise transformation, and scaled services delivery. We partner with enterprise customers to identify where AI can transform their businesses and build solutions leveraging OpenAI's models and products. We work with many of the world's largest and most influential companies to solve their most complex business challenges using the latest advances in AI.

People who thrive at DeployCo get excited about ambitious and complex work. We are deep believers in the future with AI. We execute quickly, value intellectual honesty and empathy, and obsess over the solutions we build for our customers.

DeployCo is being built from the ground up as a subsidiary of OpenAI and funded with a partnership of outside investors.

About the Role

We are seeking a designer who combines human-centred design with technical AI expertise to help people discover what AI makes possible, build useful AI-enabled workflows, and help leaders reshape how their organisations work around this technology.

Our design capability shapes AI products and experiences for customers and employees, and helps organisations rethink how people, teams and AI work together. Our ‘AI Organisations’ work focuses on closing the gap between what AI can do and the value businesses get from it, addressing the human and organisational changes needed alongside engineering and AI product delivery.

We help people explore what’s possible through experimentation on work they understand, building curiosity, confidence and judgement. Alongside this, we work with leaders and teams to test how roles, structures and working practices could change, creating the conditions for AI-empowered teams to thrive.

You might come from service design, organisation design, human-centred design or a technology innovation background. You’ll have hands-on experience using AI to prototype and improve workflows, and be interested in building human-AI organisations: shaping how people and AI work together.

Your day-to-day will include helping teams identify where AI can make a difference, co-designing and building working AI-enabled workflows and product prototypes, and refining them through use and feedback. You’ll facilitate hands-on learning and work alongside leaders and colleagues to embed these solutions into everyday work and design and test new ways of organising work, using AI. You’ll combine design craft, technical judgement and an understanding of human behaviour to turn new capabilities into practical, lasting changes.

This role is based in Singapore, with hybrid work and customer travel shaped by deployment needs.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and facilitate AI experiences that expand what people believe is possible. Use play, guided experimentation and reflection on familiar work to help people try unfamiliar approaches, challenge results and discuss uncertainty.

  • Help participants turn their discoveries into practical ideas for their own work. Design activities and learning materials that support different levels of technical confidence and help people move from exploration to action.

  • Work alongside teams to make ChatGPT and Codex useful in everyday work. Understand their tasks, identify promising workflows and help them build confidence through hands-on use.

  • Configure tools, prototype AI-enabled workflows and products, and build useful connections to existing systems. Work with engineers where deeper integration is needed, using observation and feedback from teams to refine the solutions and how work gets done.

  • Contribute to AI transformation by helping leaders and teams examine job roles, routines, decision rights, structures, incentives and physical spaces as AI takes a more active role.

  • Design new ways of working with the people whose work will change. Make the implications tangible through prototypes and experiments, helping leaders decide what to adopt, adapt or investigate further.

You may thrive in this role if you:

Bring technical expertise

  • Understand how AI tools work, their capabilities and limitations, and their implications in real working environments.

  • Configure AI tools for specific tasks and prototype connections to external systems using APIs and integrations.

  • Exercise judgement on feasibility, reliability and data permissions, recognising when specialist engineering support is needed.

Understand human & organisational behaviour

  • Use research to understand people’s motivations, habits and concerns, including what builds confidence and trust in AI.

  • Connect technical possibilities with organisational culture, structures, incentives and working relationships.

  • Help people try new practices through practical guidance, hands-on support and feedback, so they build confidence and retain judgement as their work changes.

Are skilled in facilitation and learning enablement

  • Design and facilitate workshops and experiences grounded in participants’ own work.

  • Make technical ideas accessible, creating space for curiosity and constructive challenge across different skill levels.

  • Help people reflect on discoveries, identify useful applications and move from exploration to action.

Have AI product fluency

  • Know ChatGPT and Codex thoroughly and help people discover relevant applications for their work.

  • Help people use instructions, context and iteration effectively, and assess the quality of their AI outputs.

  • Keep pace with product developments and translate useful capabilities into practical demonstrations and experiments.

Apply workflow and human systems design

  • Map workflows and services, connecting customer and colleague experiences with the tasks, decisions, systems and structures behind them.

  • Redesign processes, roles, team structures and incentives around AI, making responsibilities, coordination and human judgement clear.

  • Prototype and test changes with the people affected, evaluating their impact and connecting team-level experiments to wider organisational change.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Software Developer

Role 

We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Engineering department. In this position, you will serve as a core software development engineer, driving key engineering initiatives and taking ownership of designing, building, and maintaining high-performance system components.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Develop and maintain software components using the C programming language
  • Implement and optimize data structures for efficient problem-solving
  • Work on Linux/FreeBSD-based systems, including basic configuration and scripting
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to understand, debug, and resolve system and application-level issues
  • Debug code using tools like GDB to identify and resolve issues in a timely manner

  • You thrive in ambiguity and feel comfortable building the path forward, viewing dynamic environments as an opportunity to construct something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner with a strong bias for action and integrity, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are an energized problem-solver who actively seeks out complex challenges, knowing that tackling tough problems yields the highest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces ongoing, respectful candor and feedback to drive collective team success over individual achievement.
  • You possess a dedicated growth mindset and continuously seek self-development and feedback to become a stronger partner and teammate.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 5+ years experience in C programming and strong understanding of core principles
  • Hands-on experience in data structures (arrays, linked lists, stacks, and trees) and their applications
  • Familiarity with operating system concepts such as process management, threading, and memory management
  • Experience with GDB or other debugging tools for troubleshooting software errors
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail

data.description:
At the American Cancer Society, we're working to end cancer as we know it, for everyone. Our employees and 1.3 million volunteers are raising the bar every single day. We are a culture comprised of diverse backgrounds and experience, to better serve our communities.

The people who work at the American Cancer Society focus their diverse talents on our lifesaving mission. It is a calling. And the people who answer it are fulfilled.

This is a 100% remote role. Candidates can be located anywhere in the U.S.


The Sr. Salesforce Solution Architect is responsible for designing and delivering well-architected, scalable, and sustainable Salesforce solutions that drive business value. This Sr. role owns the end-to-end technical vision for Salesforce implementations, ensuring solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, and aligned with both current operational needs and the organization’s long-term strategic objectives.

The Sr. Salesforce Solution Architect provides expert technical leadership across the Salesforce platform, including architecture governance, solution design, integration strategy, data architecture, and release management. This role focuses on creating high-quality, future-proof solutions while balancing immediate business demands with platform best practices, technical debt management, and maximum leverage of Salesforce capabilities.

The Sr. Salesforce Solution Architect provides expert technical leadership across the Salesforce platform, including architecture governance, solution design, integration strategy, data architecture, and release management. This role focuses on creating high-quality, future-proof solutions while balancing immediate business demands with platform best practices, technical debt management, and maximum leverage of Salesforce capabilities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the design and architecture of complex, well-architected Salesforce solutions across multiple clouds (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Nonprofit Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, etc.), ensuring adherence to Salesforce Well-Architected Framework principles (security, performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability). (25%)
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce technology roadmaps, architecture principles, standards, and best practices for CRM, data management, development, release processes, and integrations. (15%)
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to delivery teams, ensuring solutions follow governance standards, security/compliance requirements, and Salesforce best practices. (15%)
  • Collaborate with business leaders, application owners, technology teams, vendors, and stakeholders to gather requirements, evaluate options, and recommend optimal Salesforce-based solutions. (15%)
  • Support investment and prioritization decisions by clearly articulating the technical implications, risks, costs, and long-term benefits of proposed solutions. (15%)
  • Champion the adoption of emerging Salesforce capabilities to solve business challenges efficiently. (15%)

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field. Or equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • Preferred Degree: Bachelor's Degree
  • Required Certifications: Salesforce Certified Application Architect, Salesforce Certified System Architect
  • Preferred Certifications: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist, Salesforce Certified Data 360 Consultant, Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant, Salesforce Certified Nonprofit Cloud Consultant (NPC)
  • Years of experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with at least 4–5 years in a Solution Architect or Technical Architect capacity on complex implementations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Proven success designing and delivering enterprise-grade, multi-cloud Salesforce solutions with strong emphasis on architecture quality and long-term sustainability.
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce platform capabilities, declarative development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations (APIs, MuleSoft, middleware), data architecture, and security models.
  • Experience creating and governing technology roadmaps and architectural standards in a Salesforce environment.
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices (CI/CD for Salesforce), and change management.
  • Strong knowledge of data standards, compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), master data management, and security best practices like role-based access and encryption to ensure reliable data flows.
  • Excellent storytelling and visualization skills using tools like UML, process flow diagrams, and sequence diagrams to document solutions, wireframe designs, and convey tradeoffs to non-technical leaders.
  • Skill in translating business requirements into technical roadmaps, assessing risks/costs vs. benefits, and leading Architecture Review Boards to ensure solutions support organizational strategy.
  • Experience guiding teams, mentoring junior developers, and driving innovation through research on market trends, with a focus on agile methodologies and continuous improvement.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Occasional travel may be required, generally limited to 1-2 trips annually for essential business meetings and professional development opportunities (e.g., training or conferences).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Frequent sitting and use of computer equipment
  • Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting materials up to 10 lbs.
  • Availability and ability to work after hours, weekends, holidays, etc. as needed, to be on call and/or to fulfill job responsibilities and requirements.

The starting rate is $135,000 to $147,000. The final candidate's relevant experience/skills will be considered before an offer is extended. Actual starting pay will vary based on non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.

ACS provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. Further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. We are a proud equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Senior Firmware Engineer II (AI Native)
data.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Connected Devices team at Life360 owns end-to-end device software readiness across our portfolio — firmware, app, and cloud engineering working as one team to ship the trackers and wearables that keep families connected to the people, pets, and things they care about most. We're not just a firmware team: we own the full device software stack, from the hardware modules to the cloud, across the whole lifecycle — architecture and hardware bring-up through mass production and post-launch refinement.

We're moving toward a more intelligent hardware ecosystem — processing continuous multi-sensor telemetry on the device itself, in real time, within tight power and memory budgets. We're an AI-Native engineering team: AI isn't just a tool we use, it's how we work — across specifications, code, test, review, data analysis and triage. Today that means firmware running across our Tile and Pet GPS tracker lines — devices shipping in the hundreds of thousands of units.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager, Connected Devices, and works day-to-day alongside our firmware, app, and cloud engineers, quality assurance, data science, hardware, operations, and data teams.

About the Job

We're looking for a Senior Firmware Engineer II to drive low-level embedded execution, security, and hardware integration across Life360's connected devices portfolio.

You are a firmware engineer with deep roots in Electrical Engineering. In this role, application code is secondary—your primary mandate is low-level firmware architecture, hardware EE collaboration, and wireless robustness. "Senior II" means you take high ownership of complex technical challenges across the stack. You can dive into schematic reviews, troubleshoot board-level anomalies, secure communications, manage low-level RF control, or optimize radio coexistence, flexing seamlessly across new product development and fleet maintenance as priorities shift.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $109,500 to $199,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 158,500 to 185,000 CAD.Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

Drive Low-Level Firmware & Hardware Integration

  • Develop and maintain low-level drivers, DMA pipelines, and peripheral interfaces (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART) across RTOS and bare-metal environments (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX).
  • Implement reliable on-device storage architectures, flash wear-leveling strategies, and efficient Inter-Process Communication (IPC).
  • Partner closely with EE on schematic reviews, hardware validation, and building hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) stress test rigs to verify edge-case stability.

Secure the Device Ecosystem

  • Architect and maintain device security pipelines, covering AWS IoT authentication, cryptographic key storage, encryption, and signed, rollback-protected OTA updates.

Optimize RF Performance & Compliance

  • Implement low-level RF control schemes and support GNSS assistance pipelines.
  • Mitigate wireless coexistence challenges across BLE and Wi-Fi to ensure stable concurrent connections.
  • Write RF compliance firmware to pass global regulatory standards and manage formal FCC/CE compliance testing requirements.

Work AI-Natively and Support the Fleet

  • Leverage AI development tools daily to accelerate prototyping, code review, documentation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Share technical ownership of shipped products by participating in on-call rotations, field triage, and team code reviews.

What We’re Looking For

Foundation & Core Technical Bar

  • 7+ years of embedded firmware experience shipping production consumer devices at scale.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Deep proficiency in C/C++ and practical, hands-on experience with RTOS internals (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX) or bare-metal embedded architectures.
  • Strong EE fundamentals: ability to read schematics, evaluate power trees, and debug hardware hands-on using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
  • Direct experience with flash storage management and low-level peripheral buses (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART).

Security Track Record

  • Demonstrated background deploying on-device security (secure boot, key provisioning, encryption) and integrating with cloud security backends (such as AWS IoT).

Wireless & RF Expertise

  • Prior experience shipping multi-radio wireless devices (BLE, Wi-Fi, GNSS).
  • Hands-on experience with low-level RF control and calibration.
  • Proven ability to navigate RF regulatory compliance labs, including managing FCC/CE compliance testing.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience integrating cloud/app endpoints and designing complex firmware state machines.
  • Deep power management profiling (sleep modes) and hardware/software watchdog implementations.
  • Exposure to Cellular (LTE-M/NB-IoT) integration or manufacturing test line bring-up.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use — you use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) every day for real firmware work: drafting and refactoring code, debugging on-device failures, writing specs and design docs. This isn’t autocomplete; it’s a standing part of how you work.
  • Judgment and ownership — you review every line of AI-generated code as critically as you would a human PR before it ships to a device in the field. The AI writes it; you’re accountable for it.
  • Velocity — you’re expected to use AI to compress timelines that used to take weeks, from specifications to working prototype to validated on-device behavior, and to be able to explain your approach when you don’t.
  • Team leadership — you share what you learn (patterns that work, guardrails you’ve added, failure modes you’ve hit) through code review, design docs, and pairing, and you help raise the team’s AI fluency, not just your own.
  • Continuous learning — you stay current on embedded-AI tooling and techniques and bring recommendations back to the team rather than waiting for them to arrive.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

data.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Software Developer

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in Santa Clara, CA, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Branch Gateway - Platforms department. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will define strategic technical direction across the gateway framework, driving our customized Linux OS image, containerized microservices architecture, and cloud synchronization controllers. You will architect high-performance kernel data paths handling massive throughput while engaging cross-functionally to refine product requirements, establish multi-year technical roadmaps, and mentor engineering talent. By partnering closely with product managers and system architects, you will continually elevate design standards and engineering rigor across the enterprise.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Drive comprehensive design leadership for the gateway framework across all layers
  • Lead system/kernel-level platform work - iptables/nftables/netfilter/ebpf, packet tracing, performance tuning and troubleshooting.
  • Set direction for the control-plane infrastructure
  • Drive platform hardening strategy - Harden system security for public sector infrastructure, implementing TPM2, FIPS-certified cryptography, secure bootstrapping, and strict compliance standards.
  • Define engineering quality - Resolve critical customer escalations, translating systemic defects into architectural enhancements and mentoring junior engineers on design and AI-assisted workflows.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You operate with high integrity and a strong bias for action, seamlessly navigating between long-term strategic architectural vision and hands-on execution.
  • You build trust through transparent communication, embrace constructive feedback, and prioritize the collective success of the engineering organization.
  • You anchor your technical designs and decisions in solving real-world customer problems, ensuring their needs guide our platform's evolution.
  • You have a unique ability to distill complex, low-level technical challenges into elegant, simple, and highly actionable plans.
  • You seek out deep system-level complexities because you are energized by finding robust, secure solutions that deliver the biggest impact.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Deep Linux systems and platform engineering - kernel networking (L2/L3), namespaces, netfilter, routing (ip rule / ip route), and core protocols — VLANs, DHCP, DNS/mDNS
  • Strong Python and Go
  • Proven experience with MySQL-backed control planes, message-driven polling architectures, and REST-based controller sync
  • Track record of technical leadership — owning platform architecture across multiple releases and mentoring engineering teams

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • eBPF/XDP or NFLOG datapath programming; VyOS/FRR or other NOS internals
  • TPM2, FIPS/FedRAMP certification; hardware bring-up on x86 appliances with cellular modems
  • Docker/Kubernetes, multi-stage image builds, CI/CD (GitLab pipelines, Nexus artifact management, SAST/SCA tooling)
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (AWS or Azure), containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), and advanced virtualization or security solutions

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

You’ll join a senior team of DBAs and SREs responsible for the database platform that underpins many of Kraken’s most critical services. This group combines deep operational expertise with a platform mindset, designing systems that allow engineering teams to innovate quickly while maintaining strong guarantees around performance, security, and reliability.

The team is entering an exciting phase of evolution as Kraken continues to expand globally. Over the next year, we are focused on strengthening our operational excellence, evolving our database environments to support significant future scale, and increasing automation and self-service so that database operations become more efficient, at scale.

This is not a traditional “keep the lights on” DBA team. Our work centers on scaling distributed MariaDB environments, shaping reliable patterns for high-traffic systems, and transforming operational knowledge into automated, auditable workflows that uplift the entire engineering organization.

It’s a collaborative, high-ownership environment where clarity, rigor, and continuous improvement are part of how we operate. If you enjoy building robust distributed systems and designing platforms that make engineering teams faster and safer by default, you’ll find a strong home here.

The opportunity

  • Scale and tune high-throughput MariaDB clusters to support continued global expansion and new product initiatives.

  • Strengthen high-availability, disaster-recovery, and backup approaches through sound design and regularly validated procedures.

  • Reduce manual operational work by building automation, improving process consistency, and enabling safe, low-friction database workflows.

  • Improve observability and alert quality by championing meaningful metrics, reducing noise, and ensuring operational clarity across environments.

  • Enhance database security through robust access controls, disciplined patching and upgrade practices, and secure operational patterns.

  • Contribute to modern platform initiatives, including containerized environments, infrastructure-as-code workflows, and reproducible deployments.

  • Partner with service teams to drive better performance patterns, operational readiness, and database hygiene across the engineering organization.

  • Participate in our on-call rotations with a long-term focus on making on-call predictable, informed by high-quality signal and preventative engineering.

What you Bring

  • 5+ years operating MariaDB/MySQL in high-volume production environments, including tuning, replication, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong understanding of high-availability patterns, distributed database behavior, and practical failure scenarios.

  • Hands-on experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (HAProxy, ProxySQL, MaxScale, or similar).

  • Practical experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code workflows (Terraform experience ideal).

  • Solid cloud, Linux, and networking fundamentals.

  • Experience with containers and orchestration platforms (building container images and managing Kubernetes workloads at scale).

  • Strong security instincts around access control, upgrade processes, and safe operational workflows.

  • Observability expertise: monitoring, alerting hygiene, and readiness for incident response.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with SRE methodologies such as error budgets, operational reviews, or reliability programs.

  • Strong scripting or programming ability (Python or Rust preferred) used to build automation and internal tools.

  • Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

data.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations

experience_requirements.text: 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models

data.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space.
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution.

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).

Responsibilities

  • Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high.
  • Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.
  • Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.
  • Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings.
  • Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop.
  • Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments.
  • Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.
  • Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.
  • Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them.
  • Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers.
  • Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.
  • Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)
  • Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects.
  • Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match
  • Private Medical and Dental Scheme
  • Income Replacement Programs
  • Bike to Work scheme
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

The Commodities Tribe builds the systems that turn fragmented maritime, cargo and market data into a real-time view of how commodities are moving around the world. Our platforms process complex and often incomplete data at scale, powering products, APIs and analytical workflows used by customers and internal experts to understand global trade. 

As a Engineering Manager, you will lead teams at the centre of this domain as we modernise a business-critical platform and move towards a more modular, scalable and AI-native architecture. You will be responsible for building a high-performing and sustainable engineering environment: developing people, improving delivery, strengthening operational ownership and enabling Technical Leads and senior engineers to make strong technical decisions. The role is well suited to either an existing Engineering Manager or an experienced Technical Lead or senior engineer ready to take their first formal step into management.

Your mission is to

  • Guide the teams through the platform transformation, helping engineers understand, influence and adopt the new direction.
  • Partner with Product and domain stakeholders to shape the roadmap around customer value, data quality and business outcomes.
  • Develop Technical Leads and senior engineers, delegating decisions to the people with the strongest context while keeping accountability clear.
  • Maintain enough technical depth to lead credibly, challenge assumptions and support sound decision-making without becoming the default technical owner.
  • Set clear goals, milestones and delivery rhythms with the teams, balancing roadmap commitments with technical debt and platform health.
  • Build strong end-to-end operational ownership, including on-call, runbooks, incident response and follow-up actions.
  • Improve reliability and observability across the cargo data platform, addressing gaps in monitoring, alerting and data integrity.
  • Lead significant incidents affecting the domain and ensure contributing factors are understood and acted on.
  • Shape and grow your team through effective hiring, capability planning and interviewer development.
  • Develop and retain engineers through coaching, actionable feedback, meaningful goals and fair performance management.

You could be a match if you have

  • Experience leading a software engineering team, whether as an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, acting manager or senior engineer with meaningful responsibility for delivery and the development of others.
  • Strong technical foundations in backend, data or distributed systems, with enough depth to review designs, challenge assumptions and coach engineers through complex technical decisions.
  • Ability to work effectively with Product, engineering and domain stakeholders to translate business priorities into clear technical and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience contributing to the operation of production systems, including on-call practices, incident response, monitoring and follow-up improvements.
  • A strong belief in end-to-end engineering ownership, including the reliability, maintainability and operational impact of the systems a team builds.
  • A track record of setting clear goals, coordinating delivery and creating accountability within an engineering team.
  • Experience supporting the growth and performance of engineers through regular feedback, development goals and constructive handling of difficult situations.
  • Some involvement in hiring or technical interviewing, with the ability to assess candidates fairly and provide clear, evidence-based feedback.

Desirable:

  • Experience leading or contributing to the migration, modernisation or re-architecture of a long-lived production system while maintaining continuity for its users.
  • Experience with data-intensive, event-driven or ML-adjacent systems, such as data pipelines, Kafka, optimisation engines or systems where data and model correctness are central to the product.
  • Familiarity with Python and one or more JVM-based technologies, such as Java or Scala, or experience working effectively in a polyglot environment.
  • Experience partnering with Product at roadmap level, helping shape priorities rather than working solely from predefined requirements.
  • Experience developing Technical Leads or senior engineers and delegating technical ownership effectively.
  • Exposure to domains such as commodities, energy, logistics or financial markets, where data quality, timeliness and operational reliability are particularly important.

data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Software Developer

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Data Protection department. 

In this position, you will serve as a premier technical leader, defining architectural direction, designing high-performance systems-level subsystems, and driving the engineering execution of our next-generation inspection capabilities.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Architect and implement high-performance DLP engines, dictionary compilers, and distributed incident processing pipelines, setting the benchmark for clean, highly optimized systems-level C code running in production proxy runtimes
  • Own the technical direction and architectural roadmap for line-rate pattern matching, regular expression evaluators, custom dictionary compilers, exact data match (EDM), and indexed document matching (IDM)
  • Help develop next-generation Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions utilizing Machine Learning (ML) models, collaborating with data science teams to successfully deploy and integrate models in high-throughput data paths while balancing inspection capabilities against strict network latency and resource constraints
  • Establish and enforce exacting architectural standards for multi-threaded C daemons on FreeBSD/Linux, designing robust shared memory structures, high-performance Inter-Process Communication (IPC), lockless concurrency, and memory-safe subsystems
  • Serve as the technical escalation authority for critical production issues—leading hands-on post-mortem core dump analysis, deep system profiling, and leak detection

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level architectural strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces open feedback, communicates with candor and respect, and champions the collective success of the engineering team.
  • You are customer-obsessed, anchoring technical and design decisions in solving real-world challenges for both internal stakeholders and external users.
  • You are driven by innovation and intellectual curiosity, continually seeking robust, secure, and scalable approaches to complex systems engineering challenges.
  • You lead with integrity and high accountability, building trust through consistent, transparent action and technical stewardship.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 7+ years of experience with systems software engineering, including a proven track record of a tech lead driving the design and delivery of high-performance backend platforms
  • Advanced hands-on proficiency in C programming on Linux or FreeBSD runtime environments, with deep architectural expertise in Inter-Process Communication (IPC) and shared memory architectures
  • Expert-level proficiency in production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including post-mortem core dump analysis, GDB/LLDB debugging, Valgrind, and system-level performance tracing
  • Proven track record of mentoring, guiding, and multiplying the impact of systems software engineers across the organization, championing engineering excellence, conducting rigorous design reviews, and fostering continuous technical growth

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Strong familiarity with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies, including regex evaluation engines, custom dictionary compilers, and EDM (Exact Data Match) / IDM (Indexed Document Matching) profiles
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with public cloud environments (specifically AWS and Azure), including deploying, optimizing, or maintaining performance-intensive cloud-native systems

data.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

  • Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

  • Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

  • Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

  • Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

  • Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK — Media

At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

⛰️ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

️ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

 Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, here’s an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years →

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart” by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

‍ How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

We’re excited to hear from you! ❤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The opportunity
Consumer Growth helps customers get more value from the Kraken app. We improve how people discover relevant features, build confidence using them, and keep coming back. We work closely with Product, Design and Data to understand customer behavior, identify opportunities and test ideas.

Our engineers help shape what we build. You’ll bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions and own your work from the initial hypothesis through launch, measurement and iteration.

Ship fast experiments, from a couple of days to a couple of weeks, to improve conversion and retention in the Kraken app.

  • Find funnel drop-offs and turn them into testable ideas, then build, measure and iterate.

  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality React Native features for our consumer mobile app.

  • Help customers discover and adopt relevant features through improvements to customer journeys, incentives and A/B tests.

  • Use AI to build quickly, then review and ship with a high quality bar.

  • Deliver polished, user-friendly UI that makes the product feel great to use.

  • Build for correctness, accessibility, performance and reliability, with testing appropriate to the change.

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Data and Backend Engineering to define hypotheses and measure results.

  • Instrument your work so the team can evaluate customer behavior and experiment results, and use what you learn to improve, expand or stop an experiment.

  • Turn successful experiments into reliable, maintainable product experiences.

  • Proactively spot gaps and opportunities, and take ownership of the outcome.

What you bring

  • Strong experience building production mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript.

  • A product and growth mindset, focused on moving metrics rather than just shipping code.

  • Evidence of product impact: you can explain what you built, why you built it and what you learned after launch.

  • Curiosity about data, and comfort using analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Segment.

  • Experience working in a scale-up or other high-growth, fast-moving environment.

  • Fluency in using AI tools to build, review and ship code, while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and the quality of the result.

  • A strong eye for UI quality and polish.

  • A self-directed approach, with the confidence to find problems and fix them without being asked.

  • Comfort working from an ambiguous customer problem, proposing ideas and finding a small, useful change to test.

  • Collaborative working style across Product, Design and Engineering.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to haves

  • Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiments, ideally with Statsig or a similar tool.

  • Experience with large-scale consumer products used by millions of people.

  • Agency or consulting background shipping across multiple products.

  • Experience in consumer fintech, payments or crypto apps.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

data.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Software Developer

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering. You will join the Central Authority team working on the control plane for the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) product, which has redefined how security services are delivered in the cloud. You will bring your expertise in security protocols and services to a team that built the world’s largest cloud security platform from the ground up.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the technical roadmap to modernize enterprise platforms using API-first design and microservices architecture
  • Design, develop, and deploy highly resilient, low-latency, event-driven solutions while maintaining ownership from API tiers to back-end services
  • Drive a culture of quality by setting coding standards, performing code reviews, and championing TDD/BDD practices and mentorship
  • Partner with Product, DevOps, and System Architects to translate complex business needs into scalable, high-performance technical solutions
  • Manage service lifecycles via Docker/Kubernetes and ensure system health using observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 8+ years in software development (including 4+ years specializing in production-grade microservices), with hands-on experience in modern programming languages such as Java, Go, or Rust
  • Expertise in distributed data patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing) and event-driven communication (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS)
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes within AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
  • Proficiency in both SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Cassandra, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB) database design and scaling

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted developer tools, automated profiling, or AI acceleration libraries to optimize low-latency software architecture
  • Experience with Service Mesh technologies (such as Istio or Linkerd), alongside practical knowledge of chaos engineering and advanced performance testing tools
  • Active contributions to open-source projects or technical community leadership
