Lead/Staff Engineer (multiple) 

U.S.-Based Applicants Only authorized to work for any employer (NO Sponsorship Provided) 

Referral Bonus Available – bring a friend! 
 

TeamBuilder is a rapidly growing healthcare SaaS company on a mission to modernize healthcare scheduling and workforce management. We are builders, executors, and big thinkers who want to solve real world problems. We win as one team. 

We’re actively looking for an AI-forward Lead or Staff Engineer who wants to take engineering to the next level with our innovative, high-velocity team.  The ideal candidate thrives in a growing, tight-knit, fast-paced start-up environment and has experience scaling from zero to hundreds of thousands of users efficiently and cost effectively. You have led engineering work at a start-up, not just contributed to it, and you have shipped AI capabilities into real products used by enterprise customers.

  • About the Role

    This is a hands-on technical leadership role. Roughly 70% of your time will be spent on back-end development in .NET, SQL and Azure. The remaining 30% spans front-end work in React or Next.js, architecture, code review, and mentoring the engineers around you.

  • AI is central to both what we build and how we build it. You will help put AI capabilities into our product, from prompt design to guardrails to evaluation, and you will help set the standard for how our team uses AI coding tools and agents without trading away quality, security or maintainability.

    Key Personal Attributes

  • Quick study who can hit the ground running
  • Strong critical thinker who can balance competing priorities
  • Comfortable presenting and pressure-testing ideas
  • You take pride in the quality and resiliency of your code, especially when using AI
  • You lead by example, not just by title
  • Equally committed to making your teammates successful as yourself
  • A true collaborator who builds trust across engineering, product and the business
  • Comfortable navigating uncertainty and trying new approaches
  • You care as much about optimization, reliability and scalability as you do about building new things
  • You like to ship working solutions with modern technology without overengineering
  • Sophisticated, practical thinking about where AI adds value and where it adds risk

  • Required Skills, Experience and Qualifications

    Engineering Foundation

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with the .NET stack (C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework)
  • 12+ years of experience with SQL, including schema design, query optimization and performance tuning
  • Hands-on experience building production front ends with React and/or Next.js
  • Deep experience configuring, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure cloud services
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, repos and work tracking in Azure DevOps
  • Experience with Redis, SignalR and a distributed event bus
  • Experience implementing Domain-Driven Design (DDD) patterns
  • In-depth understanding of software design and architectural patterns, including microservices and event-driven architecture
  • Advanced understanding of Git to manage code in a multi-developer environment

  • AI in Products and Advanced AI Developer Workflows

  • Demonstrated, enterprise-level experience implementing AI features in production products, not only prototypes
  • Experience designing, writing, versioning and testing prompts for LLM-powered features
  • Experience implementing AI guardrails, such as input and output validation, content filtering, PII and sensitive-data protection, grounding and hallucination controls, and fallback behavior
  • Experience evaluating and monitoring AI features for quality, cost, latency and reliability
  • Experience integrating LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI or Anthropic into .NET services
  • Advanced daily use of AI developer workflows, including AI coding assistants and agents, for design, development, testing and documentation
  • A rigorous approach to reviewing code, including AI-generated code, for correctness, security, performance and maintainability

  • Leadership and Collaboration

  • Experience leading engineering teams or initiatives in a dynamic start-up environment
  • A strong individual contributor who can also coach, mentor and unlock others
  • Experience working in teams with a mix of onshore and offshore contributors
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

  • Nice to Have

  • You've come from a start-up that serves large enterprise clients
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agentic workflows or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Experience with Semantic Kernel or similar AI orchestration frameworks
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment, including HIPAA or SOC 2 practices
  • Big data and analytics experience
  • Master's or other postgraduate degree

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Location: West coast

Why You'll Love This Role

Value Engineering is a consultative team that supports the Cribl sales and GTM organization and engages customers to explore the business value of Cribl. We deliver high-touch customer engagements while building content, frameworks, tools, processes and best practices to help sellers independently develop the business case for Cribl. In this highly cross-functional role, you'll collaborate with teams from sales, solutions engineering, product marketing, and customer success. Approximately 80% of your time will be focused on customer engagements and ~20% of your time will be working on broad GTM and value selling scale projects. Together, we'll drive value selling across the GTM organization, directly contributing to:

  1. Boosting win rates,
  2. Speeding up sales cycles,
  3. Reviving dormant opportunities,
  4. Increasing deal sizes, and
  5. Enhancing deal margins.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...

Your Impact

  • Engage, Consult and Influence: Partner with sales teams and customers, employing a value-based selling approach to create compelling narratives and business cases. You'll help the customer answer the 3 key questions: "Why change?", "Why Cribl?", and "Why now?"
  • Lead Discovery Sessions: Conduct technical value discovery sessions with senior executives and technical staff, asking questions and providing insights that help shape their business case for Cribl.
  • Craft Business Cases: Develop comprehensive business cases for new business, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, as well as value realization analyses to propel renewals.
  • Innovate and Build: Create value discovery questions, financial models, and frameworks for new use cases and products. Develop and maintain a value metrics database for internal and customer use.
  • Empower Sales Teams: Enable our sales teams to become proficient with self-serve value content and tools, ensuring they can independently explore and communicate value to customers. 
  • Travel Opportunities: Enjoy a dynamic role that includes occasional travel (10% to 20%) throughout the year. There is the usual customer travel, but what you should really look forward to is Cribl Kickoff, which occurs over a week each year. It’s an incredible time to engage, learn and most importantly, have fun with other Criblians.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Driven and Collaborative: You have a strong work ethic, a "get things done" attitude, and thrive in a team environment. Looking for someone who has grit.
  • Detail-Oriented and Analytical: Your structured thinking and keen eye for value enable you to create detailed and accurate business cases. You excel in financial analysis and modeling, particularly around TCO and ROI concepts.
  • Proactive and Adaptable: You're a self-starter who thrives in unstructured, fast-paced environments and enjoys taking ownership of projects.
  • Trusted Advisor: You build and maintain strong relationships with customers and sales teams, providing valuable insights and guidance.
  • Polished Communicator: You can present complex analyses clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Selling Expertise: Familiarity with Force Management, Challenger Selling, MEDDPPICC and 3 Why methodologies.
  • Technical Expertise: You have expert-level skills in Google Sheets and Slides. Being familiar with tools like Omni, SFDC, Clari, Decision Link, Ecosystems, Mediafly, and Spotlight is a plus.Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree is required, with a preference for business management, finance, accounting, economics, information systems, or computer science. A MBA from a top-tier institution is highly preferred.
  • Experienced Professional: For the Senior VE role looking for 5 to 10+ years in enterprise software strategy / business operations, technology / management consulting, investment banking or value engineering. 
  • Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with networking, cloud infrastructure, IT operations, observability, and/or security is a plus.
  • You live in the West Coast
  • As a Value Engineering team we breathe, eat and drink the four key values below …
    • Demonstrate Accountability & Extreme Ownership: Proactively identify challenges and drive solutions. Do not call out a problem without proposing a solution or framework to find a solution. We are all equity holders - act like an owner. 
    • Manage Ambiguity & Complexity: Like pioneers crossing the great plains, we must thrive in a VUCA (Volatile, Uncertain, Complex, and Ambiguous) world. We utilize frameworks and curiosity to break down complex business problems into clear, actionable insights.
    • Embracing a Continuous Improvement Mindset: Continuously push the envelope. "What is 'done'?" It is the enemy. We are OBSESSED with pushing the envelope. Status Quo? Don’t know her. Our competitors always get a say so even when we are operating at the top of our game, there is a need to continue to push the envelope and improve on the margins to stay on top.
    • Consistently acting with speed & accuracy: Operate with a bias for action, purpose, and intention. Time is our enemy. 

#LI-JK1
#LI-Remote

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.
In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range

$170,000—$200,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver features, improve existing workflows, and solve real customer problems.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Document Processing (US Remote)
data.description:
TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company. Our mission is to facilitate collaboration between payers and providers for mutual benefit and waste reduction, ultimately improving access to healthcare. We achieve this by aligning the common goals of payers and providers and fostering collaboration through a shared technology platform and seamless workflows.

Joining TREND Health Partners means becoming part of a dynamic, growing organization that promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment. Our comprehensive compensation package includes competitive salaries, highly valued health insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, and more.

The Principal Software Engineer will lead the development of innovative, scalable software solutions that support complex document review workflows for healthcare payers and providers. This role requires a deep understanding of modern web application architecture and cloud-native backend systems. The engineer will collaborate closely with architects, product, QA, and cloud teams to drive system-wide design decisions, optimize platform performance, and deliver new capabilities to our customers.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical leadership, a hands-on approach to coding, and the ability to mentor other engineers while ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business goals.

Role and Responsibilities

    • Lead the evolution of our document processing pipeline: designing Step Functions state machines, writing the modular Go services that run inside them, and defining contracts that let workflow steps be swapped in and out cleanly.
    • Own the hard problems around processing real-world PDFs reliably at scale — malformed input, structural variance, and performance across documents from a few pages to tens of thousands.
    • Build out operational metrics and observability — starting with the document pipeline, extending to other platform areas as needs surface.
    • Take a concept from "here's roughly the problem" to a shipped, working solution with minimal hand-holding.
    • Mentor and grow the other engineers working in this space, and advocate for the pipeline's forward progress.
    • Contribute to database design and query performance across our Postgres/RDS environment.
    • Work with OpenSearch for indexing and search functionality tied to document data.
    • Support the wider platform ecosystem beyond the core pipeline as needs come up.
    • Review code, weigh in on architecture, and help set technical direction for the team.
    • Partner with product and engineering leads to turn loose requirements into real technical designs.

Qualifications

  • Documented professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems — we're looking at what you've built and owned, not just tenure.
  • A habit of taking ownership of the problem space, driving the solution, and standing behind your decisions. We don't do blame here — when something goes wrong, we own it, learn, and move forward.
  • Strong Go experience, particularly for backend/service work.
  • Hands-on experience with document processing at scale — you understand PDF structure and edge cases well enough to reason about performance, reliability, and failure modes across variable real-world input.
  • Experience designing and implementing metrics and observability for production systems — deciding what should be measured and building it, not just consuming dashboards someone else built.
  • Comfort with AWS serverless patterns: Lambda, Step Functions, ECS, and event-driven architecture generally.
  • Solid database fundamentals — schema design, query optimization, troubleshooting performance issues.
  • A track record of driving something from an ambiguous starting point to a finished product.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound calls without a lot of oversight.
  • Strong communication — you'll need to explain tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers alike.
  • Experience mentoring engineers day to day — not just leaving comments in code review, but actively growing the people around you.
  • Comfort handling sensitive data (PHI) responsibly and in line with HIPAA requirements.

​Preferred Skills​

  • Proficiency in C++ — not required, but a plus given some of our high-performance pipeline segments are written in it.
  • Interest or experience in Rust — not currently in use, but on the table for future performance-critical pipeline work.
  • Hands-on OpenSearch (or Lucene-based search) experience. This space doesn't have a dedicated owner today — if it's a strength of yours, there's a real opportunity to take charge of it.
  • Experience with document-centric pipelines (OCR, classification, extraction, or similar).
  • Healthcare or payment-integrity industry background.
  • Comfort using agentic coding tools as part of a modern dev workflow.

    A Note on Culture

    We're a laid-back team — plenty of memes, self-managed accountability, low ceremony. We care more about whether the work is good and the pipeline is reliable than about how you got there. We're Mac-shop, and we lean on modern tooling (including AI-assisted coding) without letting it replace engineering judgment.

Mental and Physical Demands

  • This position will be exposed mainly to an indoor office environment and will be expected to work in or around computers and printers.
  • The nature of the work is sedentary, and the employee will be sitting most of the time.
  • Essential physical functions of the job include typing and the repetitive motion to utilize computer software and hardware continuously throughout the day.
  • Essential mental functions of this position include concentrating on analytical tasks, reading information, and verbal/written communication to others continuously throughout the day.

Related Duties As Assigned

  • This job description documents the general nature and level of work but is not intended to be a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this position. Consequently, employee’s may be asked to perform other duties as required.
  • Employees may also be asked to complete certain compliance requirements set forth by our Business Partners in the performance of their jobs including but not limited to requests for background and drug screenings and disclosures of personal health information or personally identifiable information. Exemptions as provided under the ADA and TITLE VII of the Civil Rights Act will be observed and followed.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions outlined above.

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus in our Engineering department as a Principal Civil Structural Engineer. In this role, the candidate will design and detail mat and pier type foundations for substation structures. Additionally, the candidate will design substation structures ranging from simple equipment supports to overhead line towers. All work will be performed with emphasis on quality and project costs following client’s requirements and internal company’s quality control and quality assurance practices.

The candidate may also complete substation designs, as necessary. Work will include applying applicable codes and client standards to design general arrangements, equipment and electrical layouts, elevation views, grading and fence plans, foundation plan and details, substation rigid bus arrangements, structure details, and bills of material.

This position may be based in Lake Mary, FL; Palm Beach Gardens, FL; Las Vegas, NV, Boise, ID; Raleigh, NC; or Fort Worth, TX offices or remotely in the US or Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Develop overall conceptual design plans in the initial development phase of new projects.
  • Work with renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.
  • Design foundations using commercially available software such as LPILE.
  • Develop steel structure models for rigid bus and equipment supports.
  • Perform company’s Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) processes.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with our external business partners; Present information and respond to questions from individual or groups of clients.
  • Direct and/or participate in client meetings/job site visits to collect or deliver design and engineering data.
  • Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management skills.
  • Coordinate with other engineering disciplines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors of Science or Masters in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited institution.
  • 15+ years of experience performing civil structural engineering calculations.
  • Proficient with drafting programs such as AutoCAD and MicroStation a plus.
  • Active Professional Engineering (PE) license
  • Experience in transmission, distribution and generating stations is a plus.
  • Must have strong analytical and computer skills. Must be able to identify necessary software to complete needed design work.
  • Experience leading and mentoring a team

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

data.title: Backend Engineer, New Grad
data.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, New Grad to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build the software infrastructure behind our telehealth platform.

This role is designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers who have strong programming fundamentals, enjoy building software, and want to gain hands-on experience developing production backend systems.

You'll work on APIs, databases, backend services, and application logic that support patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.

Our engineering stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, receive feedback through code reviews, and gradually take ownership of more complex features as your technical skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious, takes initiative, learns quickly, and enjoys understanding how software works beyond the code they're assigned to write.

You don't need years of professional experience or previous healthcare industry experience. We care about your technical foundation, the projects you've built, your ability to solve problems, and your willingness to learn.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend features that support Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Develop APIs, application logic, and backend services using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Work with SQL databases to create, update, and retrieve application data.
  • Help implement backend functionality for patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.
  • Learn how our serverless infrastructure works using AWS, SST, and related technologies.
  • Assist with building and maintaining integrations between internal services and third-party APIs.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable code that follows established engineering practices.
  • Create automated tests to verify functionality and help prevent regressions.
  • Debug application issues, investigate errors, and work with experienced engineers to resolve problems.
  • Participate in code reviews and learn how to give and receive constructive technical feedback.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to understand how APIs connect to user-facing applications.
  • Work with product managers and engineers to understand requirements and break projects into manageable tasks.
  • Learn how to design database schemas, structure backend services, and organize application logic.
  • Help maintain documentation for APIs, backend features, and development workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, and accelerate development while validating generated code.
  • Learn how to test changes in staging environments before releasing them to production.
  • Assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting backend services.
  • Contribute to improving existing code, reducing technical debt, and simplifying development workflows.
  • Take ownership of smaller features and gradually work toward independently delivering more complex projects.
  • Ask questions, share ideas, and actively participate in technical discussions.
  • Develop an understanding of security, data privacy, and reliability requirements for healthcare applications.
  • Continue building your technical skills through hands-on projects, feedback, and collaboration with the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Recently completed or currently completing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and basic software design principles.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another modern programming language, with an interest in developing backend applications using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Experience building software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or professional work.
  • Basic understanding of how APIs, servers, and web applications communicate.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and basic SQL concepts.
  • Understanding of Git or another version control system.
  • Ability to write readable, organized code and explain your technical decisions.
  • Familiarity with debugging, testing, and solving programming problems.
  • Interest in learning backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and production software development.
  • Willingness to use AI-assisted development tools while understanding, reviewing, and validating the code they produce.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask thoughtful questions when needed.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with other engineers and incorporate feedback.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and taking responsibility for assigned work.
  • No previous healthcare industry experience required.

Nice to Have

  • Internship, co-op, freelance, or project experience involving backend development.
  • Experience building applications with TypeScript, JavaScript, or Node.js.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, tRPC, or similar API technologies.
  • Experience using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or another SQL database.
  • Familiarity with Prisma, Drizzle, or other database access tools.
  • Exposure to AWS, SST, serverless applications, or cloud deployment.
  • Experience building full-stack applications using React or Next.js.
  • Experience deploying a personal project or application to a live environment.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks or test-driven development.
  • Experience building projects involving third-party API integrations.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of completed technical projects.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or other AI-assisted coding tools.
  • Interest in healthcare technology, SaaS platforms, or e-commerce systems.
  • Familiarity with application security, authentication, and data privacy fundamentals.
  • Experience working on a team-based software project using Git and code reviews.

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs

Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term.

As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment.

We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. 

What the work looks like for our data team: 

  • Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement
  • Serve as technical partner to program teams
  • Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies
  • Load-test our systems to prepare for elections 
  • Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching
  • Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness
  • Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting

Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar.

This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar
  • Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts
  • Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones
  • Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review
  • Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers
  • Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles
  • Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power
  • 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow
  • A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end
  • Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them
  • Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers
  • Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data
  • Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters
  • Experience on Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers

We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply.

    • Base salary of $90,000-$150,000
    • Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off
    • Remote first culture with teammates all around the country.
    • This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible.

Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time.

Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. data.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go / AWS Streaming)
data.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Senior Backend Engineer builds the backbone that connects devices in the field to the data that drives decisions. Every event from every endpoint flows through systems you design.

You will build and own high-throughput backend services in Go that ingest device telemetry through AWS IoT and Kinesis, process it in real time, and land it in Redshift for analytics and reporting. Your systems have to handle spikes without losing a single event, scale without anyone stepping in, and stay cheap enough to run at volume.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are hiring someone who has run streaming pipelines in production, has been paged when they broke, and has made them better every time.

Job Description:

  • Build backend services in Go: You design, build, and maintain production Go services and APIs that are fast, concurrent, well tested, and easy for the next engineer to understand.
  • Own device ingestion: You build the path from device to cloud on AWS IoT Core, covering device connectivity over MQTT, authentication, message routing, and the rules that hand data off downstream.
  • Run real-time streaming pipelines: You design and operate Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose pipelines, with partitioning strategies, consumers, retries, back-pressure, and dead-letter handling. Throughput is high and no data gets lost.
  • Model and load the warehouse: You design Redshift schemas, distribution and sort keys, and loading patterns that keep queries fast as data grows. You make sure the data that lands is correct, complete, and ready for analytics.
  • Own reliability and cost: You build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards across the pipeline with CloudWatch or similar tools, and you track latency, data loss, and AWS spend. You know the cost per million events and how to bring it down.
  • Raise the engineering bar: You lead design discussions, review code, write clear technical documents, and mentor other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • Senior backend engineer: 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years writing production Go. You understand goroutines, channels, and the concurrency patterns that hold up under load.
  • Streaming in production: You have built and operated streaming data pipelines with AWS Kinesis, or a comparable system such as Kafka, at meaningful scale. You understand ordering, partitioning, exactly-once and at-least-once delivery, and replay.
  • AWS IoT or device data: You have worked with AWS IoT Core or another device-telemetry ingestion platform, including MQTT, device authentication, and high-fan-in workloads.
  • Data warehouse experience: You have designed and optimized Amazon Redshift, or a similar warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery, for production analytics. You write strong SQL and know how to make slow queries fast.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: You are strong on AWS (Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and comfortable with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CDK, Docker, and CI/CD.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain an architecture trade-off to a US product team in plain English and write design documents people actually read.

Staff Software Engineer, Ground & Control Services

About Us:

BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

The Ground & Control team is looking for a passionate and driven Software Engineer to join our team, the group responsible for building the autonomous software that controls and monitors BlackSky’s satellite constellation. This includes high-speed tasking, ground and space telemetry, health monitoring, and low-latency communication with ground stations worldwide. In this role, you’ll develop software that bridges the gap between hardware-level interfaces and cloud-deployed microservices. You’ll contribute to mission-critical systems that keep our satellites safe, responsive, and efficient; operating 24/7 with minimal human intervention.

Success in this role means having a strong sense of initiative and ownership, a deep curiosity for how complex systems work, and the discipline to trace and validate requirements while thoughtfully challenging them when needed. You understand the importance of safety, precision, and testability, especially in autonomous systems where small errors can have big consequences. You’re comfortable applying modern software development practices and navigating both low-level and cloud-based technologies. data.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Health Insurance

You will collaborate with our customers, internal teams, architects, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to troubleshoot complex and challenging issues.

This position extends well beyond product support as you will be a trusted partner to our enterprise customers by offering developer-to-developer assistance for cloud-native service development and architecture; you will work closely with junior and senior engineers and developers, fixing and improving code and identifying automation opportunities.

You'll partner closely with development engineering teams and work alongside some of the brightest developers in the open source community. You will also work with Red Hat’s key strategic cloud partners to jointly solve customer Multi-Cloud issues.

What you will do:

Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

The Role

As our Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the maintainability and scalability of the infrastructure that powers Inato's platform. Reporting to Bastien, our CTO, you will split your time between projects that strengthen our infrastructure and run work that keeps it healthy.

Until now, infrastructure work has been a shared responsibility between all members of the tech department. Now that we have multiples teams, more complex services, and a rapidly growing volume of patient data and system integrations, we believe it's time for a dedicated position. This is a high-ownership, senior individual-contributor role: you will inherit a functioning system, and be responsible for bringing it to the next level.

Your success will be measured by the impact of your projects on product delivery, and your ability to prevent and solve production issues.

Responsibilities

  • Lead projects that improve the maintainability and scalability of our cloud infrastructure

  • Own day-to-day infrastructure operations, solving problems directly or making sure they are dispatched to the right team

  • Coach other tech team members on how to best leverage the capabilities of our cloud infrastructure

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 5+ years in a similar role (infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps)

  • Strong experience building and maintaining highly available cloud infrastructure environments using code, directly supporting product delivery

  • Deep understanding of Linux systems, containerization and orchestration

  • Solid networking fundamentals

  • Excellent communication, able to translate between technical and non-technical audiences

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with GCP

  • Experience as the first or sole dedicated infrastructure hire

  • Experience in a regulated or healthcare environment

Concrete project examples

  • Redesign our IAM model. Move us from ad-hoc, hand-managed permissions to a clean least-privilege structure managed as code, making access auditable, consistent, and easy to reason about as we scale.

  • Centralize our logging. Re-architect how we handle logs so everything flows into a single dedicated sink project, giving the team one reliable place to observe and debug across environments.

  • Bring our cloud costs under control. Build cost visibility and guardrails into our GCP footprint, surfacing waste, setting budgets and alerting, and making cost a first-class signal in how we run infrastructure.

Technical environment

data.description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.
We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for the build system and build infrastructure of a large, complex software product — from compiling and packaging hundreds of interdependent components to assembling, signing and publishing the artifacts we release — and for making the build fast, reproducible and trustworthy for everyone who depends on it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO  

  • Own, design and evolve the build system for a product assembled from a large number of interdependent components written in several programming languages.
  • Build and maintain the build pipelines end to end: isolated and reproducible builds, dependency and version management, build agents and build farms, artifact repositories and caching — and keep build times, success rates and reproducibility under control as the product grows.
  • Assemble and validate release deliverables: packages, images and installation artifacts, and the repositories they are distributed from, for several supported release lines maintained in parallel.
  • Build and operate the release pipeline: automated build validation and regression gating, artifact signing, promotion between channels, and the publishing and rollback procedures around a release.
  • Keep the product buildable through toolchain and dependency upgrades: resolve compiler, library and dependency conflicts, and keep build definitions and downstream patches maintainable instead of accumulating.
  • Maintain traceability of everything we ship: versioning and changelogs, artifact provenance, license and SBOM data, and the integration points that security scanning and audits rely on.
  • Automate build tooling, release steps and the provisioning of build environments in Python and shell, and integrate the build with the team's source control, review and issue tracking workflows.
  • Support developers and QA day to day: fast self-service builds of branches and merge requests, quick diagnosis of build and packaging failures, and unblocking people whose work is stuck behind the build.
  • Extend CI/CD coverage: validation on every commit, promotion of artifacts between environments, and integration of automated test suites into release gating.
  • Own the build infrastructure itself — build hosts and builder images, artifact storage, capacity planning — working with IT and operations where infrastructure is shared.
  • Investigate complex and intermittent build failures and drive them from root cause to a permanent fix rather than a retry.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for development, code and log analysis, debugging, root-cause investigation and technical research.
  • Document the build and release processes so that they are reproducible by someone else, and share that expertise with the development and QA teams.
  • Maintain clear communication with the development lead on build and release status, risks, dependencies and critical issues.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years in build, release or DevOps engineering for complex software products, including ownership of a build system as a whole and not only of individual CI jobs.
  • Strong CI/CD engineering: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or comparable; pipelines as code, build agents, and artifact repositories.
  • Solid experience with software packaging and the distribution of binary artifacts on Linux, including artifact signing and repository or channel management.
  • Ability to read, fix and take over build definitions written by other teams across multiple languages and build tools (make, CMake, autotools, and language-native build and packaging tooling).
  • Deep understanding of dependency and version management, reproducible and hermetic builds, incremental builds and build caching.
  • Solid Python and shell scripting for build tooling and release automation.
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge, plus containers and configuration management tooling.
  • Confident with Git and with branching and release models in a product that maintains several releases at once.
  • Experience delivering updates to already installed software — channels, staged rollout, acceptance and rollback — is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with software supply chain practices: signing, SBOM, dependency and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience scaling a build system — parallelism, distributed builds, cutting build times from hours to minutes — is a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and the patience to take over a large inherited build system with incomplete documentation.
  • AI-assisted engineering experience is mandatory, including practical use of AI for development, debugging, log analysis, investigation and technical research.
  • Demonstrated ability to treat the build as a product that the rest of engineering depends on, and to share technical expertise across teams.
  • Excellent English communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Please submit your resume and application in English 

WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is usd by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses. 

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to support the Digital Health Data Platform (DHDP) by driving CI/CD, infrastructure automation, deployment, environment configuration, monitoring, and operational support across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD. In this role, you will work closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud/Infrastructure, Security, and QA teams to ensure DHDP changes are deployed securely, consistently, and according to established architecture, security, and change-management requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines across DHDP environments
  • Automate deployment and controlled promotion across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD
  • Maintain environment-specific deployment configuration and parameters
  • Ensure deployments are version-controlled, repeatable, traceable, and auditable
  • Troubleshoot deployment and pipeline failures
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code, preferably using Terraform, to automate provisioning and configuration of DHDP Azure resources
  • Maintain reusable infrastructure modules and minimize configuration drift
  • Support DHDP services including Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Event Hubs, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB integrations, Monitor / Log Analytics, and Purview components
  • Collaborate with Cloud teams on networking, DNS, Private Endpoints, and shared infrastructure
  • Automate deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, notebooks, data pipelines, and configuration, and implement and maintain Databricks Asset Bundles

  • Integrate CI/CD with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Service Principals, and Azure Key Vault, applying least-privilege principles to deployment identities
  • Ensure credentials and secrets are securely managed and not stored in source code
  • Support automation of DHDP access-control configuration where applicable
  • Maintain deployment consistency across all DHDP environments and support release promotion, configuration validation, rollback, and recovery
  • Ensure production data and credentials remain isolated from non-production environments
  • Support DHP/DHDP change-control processes and maintain deployment evidence
  • Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and monitor Databricks jobs, deployments, and infrastructure
  • Troubleshoot operational issues and support root-cause analysis
  • Maintain Git-based development and Pull Request workflows

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, with hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps / GitHub CI/CD, and Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience with Azure Databricks and Databricks Asset Bundles

  • Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and Service Principals
  • Familiarity with Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Azure networking, and Private Endpoints

  • Proficiency in English at a B2+ level

Nice to have

data.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Headquarters: Czechia
URL: http://bloomreach.com

Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer. You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us?

What tech stack do we have for you?

  • Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab
  • Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub
  • Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry
  • Python, Golang

Minimum requirements:

At least 5 years of production experience with:

  • Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production
  • GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives
  • Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance

If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244, Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243

How to know if you are a good fit:

The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position:

  • Design and Specification: You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others.
  • Cross-team Leadership: You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you.
  • Independent Delivery: You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made.
  • AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement: You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship.
  • Continuous Learning: You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them.
  • Conference Participation: You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field.
  • Configuration Proficiency: You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few.
  • Resource Optimization: You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs).
  • Cluster Management: You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster.
  • Terraform Proficiency: You have written a Terraform module with multiple interconnected resources.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: You have experience setting up monitoring systems and configuring alerts. On-duty experience is preferred, along with experience with Grafana and Prometheus.
  • DevOps and CI/CD Experience: You have experience with DevOps, Orchestration/Configuration Management, and Continuous Integration technologies, including Terraform, GitLab, Ansible, and Docker.
  • Team Onboarding and Training: You have experience with onboarding and training new team members, demonstrating your leadership skills and commitment to team growth.

About your team:

The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind. Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications.

The role of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization.

Tasks and responsibilities:

In the position of Staff DevOps Engineer, you’d be expected to work with other Engineering teams to design sustainable infrastructure, microservice solutions, and an efficient and robust production environment. Additionally, you’ll be working on a variety of tasks and projects, including automating tools and infrastructure to reduce manual work, monitoring applications and participating in an on-call rotation as required.

You’ll own the design and specification of infrastructure initiatives, break them down into tasks the team can execute, and lead projects that span multiple engineering teams. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, and you retain full understanding of, and responsibility for, what gets shipped.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning new things, creative, willing to take the initiative, and able to think outside the box to solve problems strategically.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. 

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. 

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

data.description:
Headquarters: Cyprus
URL: http://gomining.com

Description

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to develop and operate GoMining's cloud platform.

The primary focus of this role is GCP and Kubernetes, infrastructure and application delivery automation, and the reliability and security of production services.

You will maintain and improve our existing infrastructure, contribute to the development of the next generation of our platform, and help product teams ship changes safely and efficiently.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and operate infrastructure in GCP, including GKE, virtual machines, networking, load balancers, storage, and managed services.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform: develop modules, manage state and dependencies, ensure reproducible changes, and identify configuration drift.
  • Operate Kubernetes: upgrade clusters and platform components, configure autoscaling, workload placement, network policies, and resource allocation.
  • Develop CI/CD and GitOps using GitLab CI and Flux / Argo CD, automating builds, checks, deployments, controlled releases, and rollbacks.
  • Build observability across metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting. Define and improve SLIs/SLOstogether with engineering teams.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents and performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and eliminate recurring failure patterns.
  • Implement least-privilege access, environment and service isolation, secure secrets management and rotation, and infrastructure audit controls.
  • Maintain backup processes and regularly validate recovery of critical data and infrastructure according to agreed RPO/RTO.
  • Help engineering teams prepare services for production, including health checks, resource configuration, telemetry, and deployment procedures.
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure usage and costs while maintaining reliability requirements.
  • Maintain infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, and recovery procedures.



Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience independently operating production infrastructure and Kubernetes, including upgrades, troubleshooting, and disaster recovery.
  • Strong experience with GCP, including GKE, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, and Cloud Storage; good understanding of Cloud SQL, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, including modules, remote state, locking, importing existing resources, and safely applying infrastructure changes through CI.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization: Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress, storage, requests/limits, probes, autoscaling, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy.
  • Experience with Helm and Kustomize.
  • Strong Linux administration skills, preferably Debian/Ubuntu: processes, systemd, filesystems, disks, and resource troubleshooting.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, routing, NAT, load balancing, and firewalls.
  • Ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues across applications, Kubernetes clusters, networks, and cloud services.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, preferably with GitLab CI, and strong understanding of Git and GitOps principles.
  • Understanding of runner permissions, secrets protection, and production deployment controls.
  • Automation skills with Bash and Python, including maintainable infrastructure scripts and API integrations.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring.
  • Practical experience operating PostgreSQL and understanding Redis and RabbitMQ, including availability, connections, replication or clustering, backup, and recovery.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles: least privilege, service accounts, Workload Identity, secrets management, network segmentation, and access auditing.
  • Ability to independently deliver infrastructure changes to a validated production result, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively with Engineering and Security teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Flux CD, Argo CD, Ansible, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing.
  • Experience migrating infrastructure between clouds or Kubernetes clusters, including database migrations with limited downtime.
  • Experience designing disaster recovery strategies and conducting recovery exercises.
  • Cloud cost optimization and capacity planning experience.
  • Experience with DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or AWS.
  • Ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript / TypeScript applications.
  • Experience operating financial or payment services with strict requirements around access control, auditing, reliability, and data integrity.



Benefits

  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote or hybrid format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days +  8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year
  • Recognition programs: structured performance reviews and team awards.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).
