data.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

Key Responsibilities

Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development

  • Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.
  • Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.
  • Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.
  • Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.
  • Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.
  • Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving

  • Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.
  • Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.
  • Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.
  • Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

Quality & Documentation

  • Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.
  • Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.
  • Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

  • D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.
  • Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.
  • Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
  • Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.
  • Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.
  • Experience working with cell-free DNA (cfDNA) or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) datasets.
  • Knowledge of bioinformatics best practices, reproducible research methods, and software version control tools.
  • Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
  • Exposure to regulated product development environments, including CAP/CLIA, FDA, or IVD development processes.
  • Experience collaborating closely with both laboratory and computational scientists.

What Success Looks Like

  • Demonstrates strong scientific judgment and analytical rigor.
  • Develops a deep understanding of assay biology, experimental design, and data interpretation.
  • Contributes high-quality analyses that inform key development decisions.
  • Builds effective partnerships across wet-lab and computational teams.
  • Continuously learns new technologies, methods, and scientific domains.
  • Grows toward increasing technical ownership and leadership within assay development programs.

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role


We are looking for a Senior Analyst - Analytics and Insights, FP&A to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based out of our Mohali Office, reporting to the Senior Manager - Analytics and Insights, FP&A in the FP&A department. In this role, you will build decision-grade analytics and forecasting capabilities by combining strong financial domain understanding with modern data and AI techniques. You will work hands-on in Snowflake, DBT, SQL, and Python to develop scalable datasets, automate planning and analysis workflows, and prototype Finance AI agents that accelerate insight generation with strong controls around accuracy and governance.


What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner with FP&A stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical requirements, deliver clear insight narratives, and drive measurable process improvements across planning and performance management
  • Model and analyze complex datasets in Snowflake using advanced SQL and Python to power recurring analysis, management reporting, and forecasting workflows
  • Build and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines and transformation logic to ensure consistent data availability, freshness, and reconciliation across source systems and curated data layers
  • Develop and support diverse forecasting solutions—spanning driver- and rule-based models with scenario toggles and sensitivity analysis alongside machine learning approaches such as time series, regression, and classification with feature engineering and backtesting
  • Build and iterate Finance AI agents that automate repeatable workflows, including controlled variance explanation drafts, anomaly detection summaries, governed Q&A over finance definitions and model documentation, and automated data refresh validation and commentary

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You take full ownership of your work, pairing strategic vision with hands-on execution and unwavering integrity to deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  • You build high-trust partnerships across teams, elevating collective success and embracing candid, constructive feedback to drive clarity and alignment.
  • You are a pragmatic builder who thrives on creating, iterating, and shipping practical v1 solutions quickly while maintaining strong technical rigor.
  • You anchor decisions in rigorous data and empirical evidence rather than assumptions, uncovering the ground truth to guide smarter financial outcomes.
  • You design durable, scalable solutions and processes that connect daily analytical execution to long-term global growth.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 4–7 years of experience in FP&A analytics, finance BI, analytics engineering, or a related analytical role with strong hands-on execution
  • Expert proficiency in SQL (Snowflake) and strong working knowledge of Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and model prototyping

data.title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics
data.description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About the role

This role turns people data into the decisions that shape how Wealthsimple hires, grows, and keeps its people. You will build the models, the analysis, and the data products that show how talent moves through Wealthsimple, where it concentrates, who is at risk of leaving, and what the workforce looks like a year out. Reporting to the Director, People Analytics, you will own that work end to end, from the question through to the thing people actually use. Success looks like recurring people decisions getting made from what you built.

About the team

People Analytics sits within People and Communications. We are growing the people domain and want to get deeper into our data, through the models, data products, and analysis that leaders across the company use to make calls about talent. We are a small team, building like a startup inside the People team. Analytics developers own the data foundation, analysts handle day-to-day reporting, and software engineers build the products that put insights in front of managers. As our first data scientist, you will help set what best in class looks like for people analytics at Wealthsimple.

What you’ll do

  • Own the model building and the deeper analysis on people data, including attrition risk, workforce forecasting, and how talent moves and develops across the company.

  • Build people data products that leaders keep coming back to, working with our software engineers to put them in front of managers across Wealthsimple.

  • Move up and down the data stack as the question demands, from raw data through to the model and the surface it lands on.

  • Turn open questions from leaders and partners across the company into analysis they can act on, and be clear about what the data can and cannot support.

  • Bring statistical rigour to how we understand talent density and performance management, forming hypotheses and testing them so people decisions are data informed.

  • Set the analytical standard for the function and raise the level of craft around you, through how we test, document, and review our work.

Skills you bring

  • 5+ years in data science or a related quantitative role, owning ambiguous problems end to end.

  • Advanced SQL and Python, applied to work you have taken all the way to production rather than left in a notebook.

  • Applied statistics and causal inference. You can pick a method, defend it, and explain why a correlation is not enough for the decision in front of you.

  • Experience building and evaluating predictive models on messy operational data, including the judgment to say when a model is not the right answer.

  • Experience turning analysis into recommendations that senior leaders act on, including pushing back when the question itself is wrong. You lead with the outcome, then explain how you got there.

  • Comfort working close to the data layer, with modelled datasets, point-in-time history, and a cloud data platform such as Snowflake.

Nice to have

  • HR data literacy: employee lifecycle events, job hierarchies, headcount types, and compensation structures.

  • Workforce planning or headcount forecasting.

  • Experience with survey and engagement data.

  • Experience measuring people performance, such as review ratings, calibration outcomes, or goal attainment.

People analytics experience helps, but it is not required. If you have done this kind of work in product, marketing, growth, or customer analytics and you are curious about people data, we want to hear from you.

Who you are

  • You are energised by building, and you do not need a paved road to do good work.

  • You think about privacy the way a good engineer thinks about security, as a design constraint rather than an obstacle.

  • You would rather ship a useful answer and improve it than hold a perfect one back.

  • You are direct about uncertainty and say what you do not know before anyone asks.

  • You move between technical and non-technical conversations naturally.

  • You are pragmatic about AI tools and know where they speed you up and where they do not.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Ground-floor impact: Most of this work hasn’t been done yet, so you’ll shape how it gets done.

  • Visibility: Your work goes in front of leadership and shapes real decisions about talent.

  • Builders around you: Your models ship into products managers use, not slide decks

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

Overview

The Analytics Engineer builds and maintains the data assets that power Ferrellgas reporting, self-service analytics, and AI initiatives. This role supports development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping turn raw source data into clean, business-ready data, builds and maintains Power BI semantic models, and automates the manual processes that slow the business down. The Analytics Engineer shares responsibility for the team’s data models and transformation code, providing coverage and continuity across the full data flow from raw data to business-ready data. The ideal candidate has strong data modeling fundamentals, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, and a builder’s mindset for replacing manual work with reliable, automated solutions.

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support
  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and support the Snowflake data transformation layer, which together serve as the foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI data agents.
  • Support development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping transform raw data into business-ready data that is structured, performant, and ready for downstream consumption.
  • Design and build transformation logic that applies business rules consistently and aligns with the team’s standards and architecture.
  • Publish and maintain well documented and performant Power BI semantic models that enable reporting and self-service.
  • Identify, prioritize, and automate recurring manual processes such as data refreshes, extracts, and report distribution.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models and validate that models answer real business questions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented SQL transformations using dbt, with Git-based version control.
  • Manage data projects end to end, coordinating with IT source system owners, the Data Warehouse team, and business end users from requirements gathering through development, testing, and delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and documentation practices established by the team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in the transformation and semantic layers.
  • Stay current with Snowflake and reporting platform capabilities and contribute ideas for improving the team’s analytics infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics, or related field).
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or a closely related role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, and query performance tuning.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks).
  • 2+ years building Power BI semantic models, with working knowledge of DAX and M.
  • Understanding of semantic layer concepts, star schema design, and dimensional modeling principles.
  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, including Git-based version control.
  • Experience with AI platforms is a plus, particularly integrating AI tools such as LLMs, Snowflake Cortex, or AI agents with enterprise data.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and documentation.
  • Collaborative team player who can work effectively with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
  • Passionate about learning new technologies and adapting to changing environments.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

Hear from our current employees and discover the people behind Ferrellgas: Employee Testimonials

data.title: Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer
data.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics
  • Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly
  • Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests
  • Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource
  • Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions
  • Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences
  • Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions
  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data
  • Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)
  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. data.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra’s solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance owns Kestra’s enterprise data platform and the standards that govern how data is used across the company. Reporting to the CIO, this role leads the transition to Microsoft Fabric, defines the enterprise data architecture, and operationalizes the Master Data Management (MDM) program. The role sets the rules, certified data models, and guardrails that allow analysts embedded in business functions to build their own reports and insights safely and consistently. This is a platform and governance leadership role, not a report development role. The Senior Manager directs outsourced engineering, administration, and development resources today, with the opportunity to build an internal team as the platform matures and serves as a trusted advisor to functional leaders as Kestra builds the governed data foundation required for AI, automation, and its evolving enterprise systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Data Platform and Architecture

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of the enterprise data platform, including the Microsoft Fabric transition plan from the current Azure-based environment.
  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including Lakehouse design, semantic models, data ingestion patterns, and environment strategy across development, test, and production.
  • Manage platform capacity, performance, reliability, and cost, and recommend licensing and capacity adjustments to the CIO.
  • Maintain continuity of enterprise analytics as source systems evolve, including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Bonafide, and retire legacy custom reports as they are rebuilt on certified models by functional analysts or delivery resources.
  • Prepare the data platform for AI and automation use cases, including Microsoft Copilot experiences, such as Copilot in Fabric and Power BI and Microsoft 365 Copilot, on governed semantic models, and data products that support embedded insights within business workflows.

Master Data Management

  • Operationalize the MDM program, including master data domains, ownership, stewardship processes, data quality rules, and supporting tools.
  • Partner with functional data owners to establish and sustain stewardship roles and data quality metrics.
  • This role sets enterprise data standards, definitions, quality rules, and controls; data owners decide on the content, quality thresholds, and access for their domains within those standards.

Data Governance and Self-Service Enablement

Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About the team

The Complex Accounts team builds the accounts that don't fit a standard mould. We own how businesses, from sole proprietorships to corporations with layered ownership, open and manage their accounts with Wealthsimple, along with joint accounts and registered education savings plans (RESPs). As we expand into more account types, the list keeps growing. It's work where accuracy, security, and regulatory requirements are non-negotiable, and we partner closely with operations, compliance, design, and product to make complicated financial structures feel simple for the people using them. We’re part of Data & Engineering, where quality, security, and scalability are the standard, not trade-offs.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Build and evolve the systems that let businesses, joint owners, and families open and manage accounts with Wealthsimple

  • Design data models for complex ownership — corporations, co-owners, and the people behind them

  • Work with compliance and operations partners to turn regulatory requirements into reliable, well-tested software

  • Improve the account opening experience across mobile and web, removing friction wherever clients get stuck

  • Build tools that help our operations teams serve clients faster and handle unusual cases on their own

  • Share on-call responsibilities and fix the root causes of recurring issues

  • Use AI tools as a core part of how you build, and help shape how the team works with them

  • Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code review, documentation, and mentorship

Skills you bring:

  • 5+ years of professional software development, with depth in back-end systems and a track record of shipping production systems that clients and teams depend on

  • Full-stack experience: you’re as comfortable contributing to a client-facing flow on web or mobile as you are to the services running underneath it

  • Experience modelling complex domains and designing systems that handle sensitive data, including authentication, fine-grained authorization, and auditability

  • A track record of shipping in a regulated domain alongside compliance or operations partners

  • An AI-first development workflow that doesn’t compromise on rigour: you use agentic tools day to day and know how to verify their output before it reaches production

  • Clear communication: you can explain a technical trade-off to engineers, compliance partners, and leadership alike

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails, React / React Native, or TypeScript

Why Wealthsimple?

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. data.title: Data Scientist
data.description:
Job Title

Data Scientist

Hiring Manager

David Corney

Salary

£41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience

Location

Remote first within the UK. We work primarily from home but also have an office available in Central London for quarterly in-person meetings with the AI team and with meetings with the rest of Full Fact. You can expect to travel to the office at least 4 times per year.

Please note that we do not hold a UKVI Sponsorship Licence, so we cannot consider sponsoring a visa applicant or issuing a Certificate of Sponsorship.

Reporting to

Senior Data Scientist

Employment Type

Permanent

We are happy to talk about flexible working, including part time.

Application Closing Date

10 am on Monday 30 November 2026.

Introduction to the role

At a moment when our information environment is under significant strain, this is an exciting opportunity: a role with real autonomy, meaningful mission, and genuine influence at the intersection of AI and web scale engineering.

As a Data Scientist at Full Fact, you will make sure those who make false claims in public can't get away with it. This is a rare opportunity to work for a non-profit tackling internet-scale misinformation problems with a global user base. The fact checks our users publish are seen hundreds of millions of times each year and embedded in many of the most well-known internet services.

Every day, 100s of people around the world find, check, archive and challenge false claims identified by AI-enabled products produced by Full Fact. Your job will be to help us improve and expand this software for our growing user base. You’ll be working at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and real-world impact.

Whether you're responding to a new feature request from users in Nigeria covering a general election, helping fact checkers in Australia verify politicians' claims in real time, or enabling health-focused charities to identify and reduce harmful content spreading online, you will be working at pace on projects that make a substantial difference in the world. In this role that means prototyping and developing features with robust APIs, writing clean Python, and working closely with engineers and other data scientists to bring AI-powered features into production.

It is an exciting time to join Full Fact. You will be joining a team of technical, data, and product specialists working on genuinely novel problems in applied AI, from natural language processing and claim detection to trust benchmarks and harm detection.

We will support you to keep learning, and if you are interested in applying but not sure you have all the skills, please do apply. We are open both to supporting learning on the job and to rearranging tasks within the team to suit the skillsets of the best applicant

Job Definition

As an experienced Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor to a number of new and ongoing projects. You will use your technical skills to design and develop software that identifies and counters misinformation. You will develop and use a variety of datasets to train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with non-technical colleagues and other users of our tools. You will participate in code review, both of your own and of others' code.

Outcomes

Some of the projects you will be contributing to include:

  • Extending our new “Public Interest AI Trust Benchmark” to provide a deeper analysis of how reliably AI chatbots answer everyday questions.

  • Spotting potentially misleading and harmful claims across a broad range of media

  • Identifying and characterising potentially harmful narratives as they spread

  • Helping to integrate the technologies you build into products that will have an immediate use, for both fact checkers and journalists

  • Identifying sightings of previously checked claims at real-time speed

  • Measuring and improving the quality of the system

What we are looking for from you

Political impartiality and sensitivity:

You are committed to the political neutrality of our work and have a good understanding of impartiality (please see the rules on our website).

Understanding of public debate in the UK and sensitivity to the political context we work in.

Skills/competencies

  • Software engineering for data science. You are familiar with the software development lifecycle. You can design, code, test, correct and document moderate to complex programs and scripts from agreed specifications with or without AI coding tools. You can use agreed standards and tools. Collaborate with others to review and refine specifications where appropriate.

  • AI and data science innovation. You are broadly familiar with recent advances in AI including LLMs. You proactively research and explore areas of innovation in our industry. You can identify the value for innovation within the organisation.

  • Applied maths, statistics and scientific practices. You understand and can help teams apply a range of practices. You know how to develop deeper expertise on a narrower range of specialisms. You can start to apply emerging theory to practical situations.

  • Developing data science capability. You promote and monitor continuous professional development within your organisation. You know how to develop knowledge of cutting-edge techniques and share this knowledge. You can develop and support data science capability across the organisation.

  • Domain expertise. You can create automated fact-checking products that are proportionate to the operational benefit and achieve significant impact. You know how to present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to communicate complex messages. You can develop data science communication skills within your team. You support the evolution of data governance and take responsibility for applying ethical data science.

  • Understanding analysis across the product life cycle. You understand and can help teams apply a range of techniques to analyse data and provide insight. You are proactive and can present compelling findings that inform wider decisions. You are starting to apply innovative approaches to resolve problems.

What we offer

A salary between £41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience.

Workplace Pension

Generous holidays:

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

  • In addition, we usually close the office for a period between Christmas and New Year.

Comfortable, centrally located London office with good transport links

Employee Assistance Programme

Emergency Housing Loan and support for moving home

Volunteering day

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter using the link below by 10 am on Monday 30 November.

Our recruitment platform will remove identifying details such as email addresses to allow us to sift applications anonymously.

Before applying, please read the requirements we place on staff to protect Full Fact’s independence and non-partisanship

How the application process will work

We want to see you at your best to understand your strengths and the contribution you could make at Full Fact with strong support, including for your learning and development. We also want to make sure that we use your time well during this process and don’t ask for more from you than we need to. We will make any reasonable adjustments we need to make to this process to help ensure you can perform at your best. For more information about this before applying, please .

The interview panel will be Ellie Ashman (Head of AI), David Corney (Senior Data Scientist), and James McMinn (Senior Engineer).

The process starts off with an anonymised covering letter and CV. This will be read by at least two people to produce a shortlist for the panel interview.

The first round interviews will be an audio (not video) interview, lasting no more than half an hour, at a time that’s convenient for you. We will record it so at least two people can review each interview to decide who we invite back for the second round. The recordings will be deleted at the end of the process.

The second round will include a structured interview during which you will be asked to present some of your recent work in any way you choose. The interview will be with the full panel by video and last no more than an hour. We’ll tell you everything you need to know to prepare in advance.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/data-scientist-full-fact

data.title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Tokyo)
data.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same.
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is ¥7,800,000 to ¥11,900,000 in Japan, plus variable bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience-levels and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Benefits:

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range

¥7,800,000—¥11,900,000 JPY

data.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions, including our AI investigations platform Ardence, that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily.

As an AI Scientist on our new AI Research team, you will build the models and agents behind the intelligence that powers TRM's products. Part of that is training foundation models on blockchain data, one of our most differentiated data layers, and part is building autonomous AI agents that generate intelligence at a scale hand-built heuristics cannot reach. You'll work on Intel Cortex and other ambitious, cross-cutting ideas, with a broad view across intelligence rather than a single risk category. This is pioneering work that does not exist elsewhere in our industry, and it directly drives customer outcomes, from seizing illicit funds to disrupting criminal networks.

The impact you'll have here:

  • Train ML models on blockchain data, including foundation models, and take them from research to production.

  • Build AI agents (and fine-tune LLMs where it helps) so the intelligence underneath TRM's products is generated by models and agents, not only hand-built heuristics.

  • Find new ways to generate net new intelligence, using patterns across all intelligence layers (Network / On-chain / Protocol) that competitors can't replicate.

  • Ship production-quality code: ML models, agents and data pipelines, with rigorous evaluation and scalable architecture.

  • Take on ambitious, high-impact bets that raise the ceiling of what our intelligence can do, and drive measurable outcomes: billions in illicit funds traced, seized, or prevented.

What we’re looking for:

  • Quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics). Advanced degree or equivalent research experience is a plus.

  • Strong machine learning foundations, built over years of applied ML and/or research (modeling, evaluation, experimentation). You don't need to have trained a foundation model or built agents before, but you need the fundamentals to do it.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset: gets to the root cause, leverages creativity, and thrives in ambiguity with a hypothesis-driven, iterative approach.

  • 5+ years of hands-on machine learning experience, with strong Python, SQL, and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code).

  • Experience with distributed data systems (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow) and shipping production ML code.

  • Strong async communication (Loom, Slack, Notion), strong technical communication in English, and ability to own work independently in a remote environment.

  • Bonus: experience with LLMs, AI agents or fine-tuning; domain curiosity or prior work in blockchain, crypto, fraud, money laundering or financial crime.

About the Team:

  • AI Research is a new team focused on ambitious, cross-cutting ideas in attribution and intelligence.

  • Fully remote and globally distributed. Most overlap occurs 7am–12pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • All team members must have at least 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

  • You'll work in partnership with the category pods, whose expert-built heuristics provide the high-confidence labels our models learn from.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid Customer Impact. Deliver last-minute, high-stakes projects for key customers — turning around attribution insights in days, not weeks.

  • MVP to Production. Build complex algorithms with tight timeframes (1-2 sprints for MVP) and iterate based on real customer feedback.

  • Parallel Execution. Juggle multiple priorities across categories and stakeholders while maintaining quality and speed.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About Revel

At Revel, we are revolutionizing the way the world's most critical hardware is controlled—across aerospace, automotive, energy, and manufacturing sectors. Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. We empower engineers to build, test, and deploy critical systems rapidly, reliably, and safely.

The role
We’re building a new data platform to add to Revel’s current products. The data platform receives, stores, and serves telemetry from our customers’ hardware. It helps customers develop and operate their hardware faster and more effectively.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will join very early in the project and help to decide how we deploy, run, and maintain the platform in every environment our customers need.

Problems you’ll work on

  • One platform, every environment. The platform must run in commercial cloud, in government cloud, and on-prem. You will design one system that deploys to all three, not three separate systems. This starts with technology choices. You will pick tools that are truly portable, not tools that lock us into one environment.

  • Environments that stay healthy. Launch is only the start. Every environment needs upgrades, patches, and sometimes hands-on hardware maintenance. You will make this work repeatable, so the effort does not grow with each new environment.

  • Security for regulated customers. Government and defense customers have strict security requirements. You will design the networks, access control, and system hardening that meet those requirements and pass audits.

  • Reliability from day one. Customers record data during hardware tests that can be expensive or impossible to repeat. You will decide what “up” means for them. You will set SLOs and error budgets, and build on-call and incident practices before the first big outage, not after it.

  • Growth in data volume. As customers connect more hardware, the platform receives more data. You will plan capacity, keep performance high, and help to control cost as the data grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own the infrastructure for the data platform in every environment: networks, firewalls, access control, capacity, and cost

  • Choose portable technology, and write infrastructure as code so each new environment follows a tested, documented process

  • Keep every environment healthy over time with upgrades, patches, tested backups, and hardware maintenance when needed

  • Agree on SLOs and error budgets with the team, and use them to decide when to ship and when to fix

  • Build the observability stack, and set the standard for alerts: few, clear, and actionable

  • Start on-call, incident response, and blameless postmortems, and make sure each incident leads to a lasting fix

  • Give engineers the pipelines, tools, and runbooks to ship and run their services safely on their own

  • Review designs with our distributed systems engineers to find failure modes and operating costs before launch

  • Lead security and compliance for government customers, and work with customer IT and security teams on deployments, audits, and accreditation

  • Help hire and mentor our second SRE

What we are looking for

  • You’ve designed and run a production environment yourself, including networks, security, and identity.

  • You choose technology for the long term. You can explain when a tool is portable enough to run anywhere, and when a managed service from one cloud provider is worth the lock-in.

  • You write infrastructure as code and automation that other engineers trust and use (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools).

  • You’ve defined SLOs and built the alerting and incident practices around them, not only followed ones someone else set.

  • You’ve run data-heavy distributed systems, including high-availability databases. You can read and change the application code that runs on them.

  • You want to make other engineers better at running their services, not do all the operations work yourself.

  • You’re comfortable with hands-on work, from cloud accounts to physical servers.

  • You want to be the first person in a role and define how it works.

  • Experience with government cloud (e.g., AWS GovCloud), FIPS or FedRAMP, air-gapped deployments, or aerospace, defense, or industrial environments is a plus.

Join us to redefine what’s possible in software for hardware.

Benefits

  • Health insurance — We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage to support you and your family.

  • 401(k) — Save for your future with our 401(k) plan.

  • Equity — All full-time employees receive equity, ensuring that you share in Revel's success and growth.

  • Life insurance — Company-paid life insurance gives you and your family peace of mind.

  • Parental leave — We offer paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents.

  • Catered lunch — We provide catered lunch five days a week, so you can stay fueled and focused.

  • Unlimited PTO — We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO for all full-time employees.

    ITAR Requirements
    To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Snow Commerce is a leading provider of eCommerce strategy, design, and digital marketing, helping some of the world’s most exciting brands succeed online. Our partners include Paramount, Netflix, Bauerfeind, NBCUniversal, Warner Bros., and more. Learn more at .

About The Role

The role is hybrid in Cincinnati, OH or Remote in the US Eastern Time Zone.

As the Data and BI Lead at Snow Commerce (part of the FYUL family), you will lead our Business Intelligence vision and data infrastructure to empower high-impact commercial and operational decision-making across our e-commerce platforms. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Experiences, you will serve as both a strategic leader and hands-on data architect scaling our cloud data warehouse, establishing rigorous data governance (including strict financial data accuracy), and translating complex metrics into actionable executive insights. If you thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment where data directly shapes customer experiences and business growth, this role offers the autonomy to build, innovate, and make an immediate enterprise-wide impact.

Your Daily Tasks Will Entail:

  • Architect & Scale Modern Data Infrastructure:Design, optimize, and maintain high-performance cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) and robust ETL/ELT pipelines to unify multi-channel e-commerce, CRM, and operational datasets.

  • Lead Enterprise Reporting & Dashboards:Plan, deliver, and maintain intuitive, scalable BI dashboards and visual models (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for executive leadership, client-facing teams, and departmental leads.

  • Champion Financial & Operational Data Integrity:Establish and execute rigorous audit protocols to guarantee 100% accuracy in financial reporting, revenue modeling, and commercial KPIs.

  • Translate Data into Commercial Strategy:Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Client Strategy to extract predictive insights, identify growth levers, and deliver compelling data storytelling.

  • Cultivate BI Team & Best Practices:Provide hands-on mentorship, code reviews, and structured project management for analytics initiatives, fostering a high-velocity, continuous-learning culture.

  • Drive Data Governance & Security:Oversee enterprise data governance, access controls, compliance, and strict confidentiality protocols to safeguard intellectual property and sensitive client data.

Your Qualifications:
